Players Committee card image of [[Stalker (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship that just moved from here (if within range).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/35aa2a66de8c2b5feeb1ad348a3a240cdc9ffbef 35aa2a6] (28 March 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
